about: The per-release smoke of docs/model-tiers.json (scripts/tier-smoke.py): one greedy prompt per Tier 1 file, its stdout byte-compared to a pin under tier-smoke/, one pin per device class and backend. The prompt asks for a fact from outside the system (expect must appear in the continuation) and keeps an instruct model generating to n_predict, and a pin holds at least min_generated_bytes of generated text, so a byte-compare has something to catch; the pin itself only says whether this build reproduces the one that wrote it. Each pin records the prompt and settings that produced it. -b is fixed because the prompt batch is otherwise sized from free RAM on a GPU build. A row may override prompt, n_predict, expect, min_generated_bytes or args.

defaults.prompt: List the eight planets of the Solar System in order from the Sun, one per line, then describe each in one sentence.
